preconditions.description: The number of crimes Zeyad would like to commit is between 0 and 10^18, inclusive.
The number of conditions Zeyad is aware of is between 0 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= mi <= 123 for ti, mi in conditions)
preconditions.description: Each crime's multiplicity is a positive integer and the product of all multiplicities does not exceed 123.

preconditions.expression: all(ord('A') <= ord(ti) <= ord('Z') for ti in conditions)
preconditions.description: Each crime type is a capital Latin letter.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of different ways Zeyad can commit exactly n crimes with no punishment modulo 12345.
